{{Quote|I see the shooter up in the tower! Over there!|The Senate Commando after spotting [[Aurra Sing]]|<ref name="TCWHostage" />}}
This '''[[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]]''' was stationed at the '''[[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]]''' on '''[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]''' in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Senate hostage crisis]] and was killed in a fight against [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] led by [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]].<ref name="TCWHostage" />

==Biography==
When Cad Bane, along with several [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]], arrived at a platform of the Republic Executive Building and landed without permission, a squad of Senate Commandos, including this one, led by Captain [[Jayfon/Legends|Jayfon]] went to arrest them. After the captain told Bane to surrender, [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] began shooting at the commandos from a nearby tower. They spread out, moving toward speeders and taking cover against them, and one member of the unit inquired as to wear the fire was coming from. This commando quickly spotted Aurra Sing, pointing toward her and relaying her location to the others, before being killed after she shot him in the head. After she shot another commando, Bane killed Jayfon before the droids and Shahan Alama also started firing at the squad. Shortly afterwards, the rest of the Senate Commandos were killed and Bane's group continued with their plan to take Republic sentors hostage in order to get [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure|Ziro]] released from prison.<ref name="TCWHostage" />

==Personality and traits==
As a Senate Commando, he was one of the best Senate Guards, well-trained in armed and unarmed combat.<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> Like the other Senate commandos on the platform, he had quick reflexes, attempting to move away from Aurra Sing's line of fire immediately after she began shooting at them. He had great awareness of his surroundings, spotting her quickly.<ref name="TCWHostage" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
This Senate Commando first appeared in '''[[Hostage Crisis]]''', the 22nd episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[March 20]], [[2009]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode022.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hostage Crisis}}</ref>.
